# DIY-QuantiFluorONE-dsDNA-Fluorometer Workshop Booklet {.unnumbered}

**Prepared for the STABLE Project (2025–2027)**  
*Higher Education Partnership for a Sustainable Blue Economy*

**eDNA Workshop 2026**  
with Dr. Achim Meyer

## About this booklet

This booklet provides the practical and technical documentation for the DIY-QuantiFluorONE-dsDNA-Fluorometer used in the 2026 eDNA workshop within the STABLE Project.

The STABLE Project, *Higher Education Partnership for a Sustainable Blue Economy*, is a three-year international collaboration (2025–2027) bringing together universities and research institutions from Indonesia, Malaysia, Germany, and the Netherlands. The partnership aims to advance and modernise postgraduate education in support of a sustainable Blue Economy.

Within this framework, eDNA-based biodiversity monitoring forms part of the research-based teaching and advanced-training activities. The DIY-QuantiFluorONE-dsDNA-Fluorometer provides an open and reproducible platform for practical dsDNA quantification during the eDNA workshop.

This booklet covers the theoretical background, hardware and mechanical design, software installation, calibration workflow, measurement protocol, quality-control procedures, analytical validation, troubleshooting, and the information required to reproduce and operate the instrument.

## Current content status

This booklet documents the current validated configuration of the DIY-QuantiFluorONE-dsDNA-Fluorometer.

The documented hardware, mechanical components, firmware, calibration workflow, measurement procedure, and analytical validation correspond to the repository version supplied with this booklet.

Any future changes to hardware, firmware, optical components, calibration procedures, or analytical performance should be documented explicitly and evaluated before being treated as equivalent to the configuration described here.
